verdict.rationale: Delegation is Marlin's core design. Its docs say the user sets a research topic, refines direction in a brief exchange, and the AI then runs the whole research process autonomously for up to about eight hours. It delivers a referenced report and slides, and the user can cancel at any time during execution. Missing for 10: delegation is limited to research and strategy-report tasks rather than general in-product tasks, there is no independent or hands-on corroboration (testimonials are hosted by the vendor), and there is little detail on how the assistant is controlled or interacted with mid-task.
